variants.name: Current architecture
variants.summary: Module level: codex-session as implemented on 2026-09-13. Follow linked subjects for related levels.

nodes.name: Codex session
nodes.responsibility: One initialized app-server session: the handshake, the reviewed methods, and what came back
nodes.description: The module this board describes. It is created for one child generation by the workbench that owns the child; follow it for the rest of that subsystem.

nodes.name: Initialize session
nodes.description: Sends the authored initialize request, writes initialized, reads configuration and account state, and advances the explicit session phase.

nodes.name: Prove isolated storage
nodes.description: Compares handshake storage facts with canonical, non-symlinked CODEX_HOME, SQLite, and config paths before the session becomes usable.

nodes.name: Gate protocol operations
nodes.description: Implements the reviewed login, thread, turn, queue, timeline, and realtime methods with login-capable and thread-capable gates.

nodes.name: Serialize request identities
nodes.description: Validates every identity-bearing request field against the current child authority and serializes only issued identities for the wire.

nodes.name: Decode response contracts
nodes.description: Defines response shapes from protocol schemas and records which identity kinds each method's result contains.

nodes.name: Adopt response identities
nodes.description: Collects all raw identities in a decoded response, adopts them in one authority transaction, and overlays their trusted brands.

nodes.name: Answer reverse requests
nodes.description: Routes current-time requests for owned threads and explicitly refuses unsupported token refresh and attestation requests.

nodes.name: Classify request failures
nodes.description: Distinguishes invalid inputs and failures that were not delivered from mutations whose remote outcome is unknown and requires inspection.

nodes.name: Workhorse start
nodes.responsibility: The caller that opens a thread on this session under an epoch transaction

nodes.name: Codex transport
nodes.responsibility: The wire under the session: one newline-framed JSON object at a time, each way

edges.label: a request the child made of us

beats.heading: Establish trusted readiness
beats.body: Initialization negotiates the fixed capability set and storage proof confirms the child is using exactly the private paths prepared for it.

beats.heading: Send only owned requests
beats.body: Operation gates enforce session readiness, and identity serialization refuses values that were not issued for this child epoch before encoding.

beats.heading: Settle every answer
beats.body: Responses are schema-decoded and their identities adopted atomically; reverse calls and mutation failures retain explicit ownership and delivery outcomes.
